bank_name: ICB Islamic Bank Limited (formerly The Oriental Bank Limited / Al-Baraka Bank Bangladesh Limited)
period_note: Filed by the bank as a '2nd Quarter' discrete filing. Balance sheet is the period-end snapshot (reported) vs 31-Dec-2021. Income-statement items recorded here are CUMULATIVE from 1 January 2022 (H1 YTD); the source also independently discloses discrete 3-month (Apr-Jun 2022) figures, not stored as separate line items. SOLO/STANDALONE basis. NOTABLE FINDING: this is a rare PROFITABLE half-year for this otherwise chronically loss-making bank -- net profit after tax of BDT +12.36m (EPS +0.02), driven by a large jump in 'Other operating income' (245.15m vs 36.05m in H1-2021) that more than offset the ongoing negative net investment income; retained earnings improved (became less negative) from -19,236,245,469 (Dec-2021) to -19,223,885,614 (Jun-2022), a delta that reconciles exactly to this period's net profit. Extensively cross-validated: the H1-2021 comparative column (profit paid on deposits -219,470,176; net investment income -81,138,808; income from shares 3,429,912; commission 2,610,962; other operating income 36,053,300; total operating income -39,044,634; operating expenses 202,458,207; PAT -212,585,394; EPS -0.32; NOCFPS 0.67) matches 2021_Q2.json's own figures exactly -- this independently confirms several sub-line figures in 2021_Q2.json that had been flagged there as lower-confidence due to that filing's own heavier OCR garbling. As in other quarters, the source's 'Total provision (D)' line is printed as a plain positive figure regardless of charge/release direction; the true sign (-20.0m, a net recovery) is derived as C minus the reported PBT.
